main_text.p: ræ dictis ex libris Propheticis & Hagiographis depromptis, misericordiam Dei sollicitat, & quamlibet tandem his benedictionum clausulis obsignat. In 1. hanc ponit clausulam: Is qui Mosi & Patribus vestris ad mare rubrum respondit, idem vobis respondeat, & vocem clamoris vestri exaudiat hodie: Benedictus esto, ô Domine qui recordaris eorum quæ oblivione dudum sepulta. In 2. hanc: Is qui in Gilgal respondit Iosuæ, respondeat vobis & exaudiat hodie vocem clamoris vestri: Benedictus esto, ô Domine, qui clangorem audis. In 3. hanc: Is qui in Mitspa Samueli respondit, respondeat & vobis &c. Benedictus esto ô Domine qui clamorem exaudis. In 4. iftam: Is qui Eliæ in monte Carmel respondit, respondeat &c. Benedictus esto ô Domine qui orationem exaudis. In 5. hanc: Is qui Ionæ in ventre piscis respondit, respondeat &c. Benedictus esto, ô Domine, qui tempore angustiæ respondes. In 6. hanc: Is qui Davidi eiusque filio Salomoni Hierosolymis respondit, respondeat &c. Benedictus esto, ô Domine, qui terræ miserëris. Cæterùm unicuique harum benedictionum universus populus reponit, AMEN. Maymon. de Ieiunio, ubi plura Vide. De Ieiuniis vid. Schindleri & Cl. Buxt. Lex. in ꝺ. Cofri 162. Synog. c. 30.
IEPHTA quorsum fugerit vide Hierof. Schevift fol. 36. 1.
main_text.l: IANNES & IAMBRES vid. Cl. Buxtorf. L. Talm. p. 945.

page.notes: The page is partly faded and some words are doubtful; the printed marginal reference column is largely illegible. The "ꝺ" in the Buxtorf reference and "Maymon" marginal word are uncertain. Entries on the lower lines are set as printed; the catchword "IRRE-" is the start of the next page's word.
